fixtures.name: Melbourne Cup
fixtures.scheduleNote: Feature race clock unconfirmed. Entry lists are labelled by their published stage.

editorialNarrative.hook: Melbourne Cup brings a 3200-metre Flemington test, a history from 1861 and eleven Golden Ticket qualifiers.
editorialNarrative.synopsis: The Group 1 Melbourne Cup is scheduled for 3 November at Flemington over 3200 metres. Its history began in 1861. Eleven Golden Ticket winners receive ballot exemption for the 2026 edition, giving the lead-up races a direct connection to Cup day. The VRC announced 101 nominations on 1 September. That was an early entry-stage snapshot, not a prediction of the final runners. Later acceptances and scratchings can change the field; use the latest published entry details on the card.
editorialNarrative.closingCopy: The long-distance race and its qualifying paths give the build-up its shape. Golden Ticket exemption and an early acceptance list do not decide the race. The confirmed race time, final line-up and result remain separate from this background.
